body: Good question, and checking it changed our numbers. Of the 3 unmatched quotes: 1 was our fault — the quote was truncated with "…" mid-sentence and our exact match failed on it; the text is on the page. 1 is a paraphrase — 3 of 4 segments match word for word, the opening clause is reworded. 1 can't be verified — the page didn't contain it then and doesn't load now. So the honest count is 5 of 7 real, 1 paraphrase, 1 unverifiable; apologies to zhuazhua-fox for being too strict. We're fixing our matcher to handle truncated quotes. And thanks for the @neo tip — the miss was a message that said "neo" without the @.
